raw_recipe.headline: Whiskey Marinade
raw_recipe.description: This marinade is so flavorful there is no need for steak sauce! Use your favorite brand of whiskey
raw_recipe.name: Whiskey Marinade

recipeInstructions.text: Stir together the whiskey, soy sauce, Dijon mustard, green onion, brown sugar, salt, Worcestershire sauce, and pepper.

review.reviewBody: I used this on a fairly thin very cheap cut of meat and it was fabulous. I did make a couple of alterations since I did not have dijon or soy sauce, substituted plain yellow mustard and teryaki sauce. everybody L O V E D IT!!!!!

Loved it! I skipped the salt, added minced garlic, swapped green onions for chives, and used Woodford Reserve Bourbon for my whiskey. I marinated thinly sliced chicken breast for 4 hours and put ‘em on the grill. Amazing! Can’t wait to have the leftovers on a caesar salad tomorrow!
I marinated some huge chicken breasts for 20 min and then I decided to just bake them for an hour in the marinade. It turned out great! Even my 3 year old loved it. I left out the salt.

I marinated boneless chicken thighs for about 5 hours. My husband bbq’d them. They were so tender, we really enjoyed the flavour as well. I used 1/3 cup whiskey, not 1/4 beacause I always like to taste the alcohol in the sauce. And I chopped up a shallot instead of a green onion, yum. I will make again but try marinating the meat longer. Very nice, thanks!

I'm a vegetarian, but I don't let that keep me from the pleasures of marinating! I let some baby portobello mushrooms sit in this overnight, then sauteed them with about 1/3 cup of the leftover marinade and a bit of oil. I am eating them right now and I seriously think they are the most delicious mushrooms I have ever tasted! The only thing I might do differently next time is omit the salt, since the soy sauce is quite salty already and the extra sodium seems superfluous.

This is a delicious marinade for those that like the whiskey flavor. I followed the recipe except I used low sodium soy sauce and omitted the teaspoon of salt because think it would have been way too salty otherwise. I used Makers Whiskey and marinated my chicken for 24-hours. Everyone thought it had a very rich flavor so I will be making it again.

It's really good! The one thing I would change is to use a bit less whiskey - it was too strong for me. We liked all of the flavors, but the whiskey is a bit overpowering. We used Jack Daniels. The marinade really flavored the meat well, even after only 3 hours. I will make this again for sure. I also boiled the marinade after removing the meat and used it for a sauce. Yum!
Absolutely wonderful!!! Maybe the best marinade ive ever used!!! I did add 2 cloves of garlic and blended everything up in the food processor. Could not have had more flavorful steak sandwiches!!!
The whole family, even the eight year old grandson loved it on a lightly smoked 1 1/2kg roticceried porc loin roast with inserted garlic slivers. Eliminated the sugar in the formulation.

Love, love, love!! My only major tweak was to use honey instead of brown sugar because I just don't keep brown sugar on hand. The minor tweak was since I used Jack Daniel's Tennessee Honey Whiskey (my absolute favorite of all time) was to reduce the honey amount by half ;-) Grilled with both boneless skinless chicken thighs and pork tenderloins (two batches of marinade) and will grill top round steak next time :-)

Beyond superb!! I really don't like the taste of whiskey straight from the bottle (can't even stand the smell!), but in this marinade, it blends with all the other flavors and creates a feast for the tastebuds! It makes the most flavorful steaks you can imagine. I only changed two things: This recipe does not need more salt, so I omitted that and I added 3 garlic cloves, finely minced. Yum!!

I ended up doubling it for 5 boneless, skinless chicken thighs, I didn't think that a single batch was enough. My husband liked it, but I did not. It was not sweet. All I tasted was the booze (I used Jack Daniels like the recipe's author did). If I try it again, I will use bourbon because I like the flavor of it in other recipes (whiskey barbecue sauce recipe on this site).
I made this for the first time tonight and the steaks were made to die for! My spouse even finished her steak and normally she would not do that! Very very good. It is a keeper! Thanks
Delicious marinade. Very flavorful. I did Add two tablespoons of olive oil to recipe.
I made this exactly as written. I marinated shrimp for an hour. The mustard flavor was overwhelming. Maybe it's good on beef, but not shrimp. Would not make this again. Sorry.

It’s great! Everyone that has
tasted it loves it.
I use Jameson Caskmates whisky
We love it!!! Now we marinade almost every dinner in it. Followed the recipe but made more marinade than called for to heat up and use as a sauce
Soy sauce is a little heavy for my taste; will use a little less next time. Quite tasty otherwise!
Do not change a thing. This marinade is awesome!
We could not eat the steak we use this marinade on the taste was terrible and over powering!
